# artisanvirt_bridge (Resource)

A persistent host-local libvirt bridge on a node, in `isolated` or `nat` mode, optionally with an IPv4 address and DHCP range. NAT and DHCP require `ipv4`. Bridges cannot be changed in place; any change replaces the bridge, which fails while VMs use it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "artisanvirt_bridge" "lab" {
  node_id    = artisanvirt_node.hv01.id
  name       = "br-lab"
  mode       = "nat"
  ipv4       = "192.168.100.1/24"
  dhcp_start = "192.168.100.10"
  dhcp_end   = "192.168.100.250"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Bridge interface name (max 15 characters).
- `node_id` (String) Node to create the bridge on.

### Optional

- `dhcp_end` (String) Last DHCP lease address.
- `dhcp_start` (String) First DHCP lease address.
- `ipv4` (String) Bridge address with prefix, for example `192.168.100.1/24`.
- `mode` (String) `isolated` (default) or `nat`.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<node_id>/<name>`.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <node_id>/<bridge_name>
terraform import artisanvirt_bridge.lab node-0123456789abcdef/br-lab
```
